title: groundtruth cadence table, version cadence/1
description: Per collection, how often the publisher itself says it releases new data, with the publisher's page and the sentence. expectedDays is a number only when a quote carries the stated cadence word and the word's days come from the closed table in validate.mjs (CADENCE_DAYS); where the publisher states no interval it is null with a reason. Never a guess. validate.mjs adds the checks JSON Schema can't say: every committed collection has one row and every row has a committed collection, expectedDays agrees with the stated word, and a quote carries that word.

statedCadence.description: The cadence word the publisher uses. Present when expectedDays is a number; absent when it is null.

expectedDays.description: The days the stated word stands for in CADENCE_DAYS, or null where the publisher states no interval.

reason.description: Present when expectedDays is null. publisher-cadence-unstated: no page of the publisher's states an interval for this data.

source.description: A publisher page that was read, and the sentence on it. For a null row the sentence is the closest the page comes (or the page saying a schedule is not yet posted); the note says why no number follows.

foundIn.description: The file that carries the sentence when the page builds its text from a script.

quote.description: The publisher's sentence, word for word, whitespace collapsed.

readAt.description: The UTC day the page was read.
